name: Discovery+
alternative: A copy of the person's discovery+ account data requested through the Warner Bros. Discovery Privacy Center or 1-866-324-3637 (covered US states and other countries with access rights), read locally
notes: discovery+ links to the Warner Bros. Discovery privacy policy, whose US State Supplement gives residents of California and other listed states a right to a copy of the personal information held, requested through the WBD Privacy Center or a toll-free line; the main policy offers access requests elsewhere depending on local law, and the Privacy Center web form is not available in every region. It is a one-off copy that may include viewing activity, not live watch history or My List access. discovery+ offers no public viewer API or MCP server; no MCP Registry entry.

name: DICE (live events)

notes: DICE's UK and US privacy policies for users say a person can get a copy of the information held about them by writing to help@dice.fm, with country policies for other markets; it is a one-off copy of account and ticket history, not live tickets, which stay in the app as QR codes. Ticket confirmation emails were not confirmed from a DICE page, and in-app VAT invoices are automated only in France and Portugal. DICE's partner GraphQL endpoint (partners-endpoint.dice.fm) serves venues and promoters, not fans; registry hits for 'dice' are unrelated.

name: Lunch Money
alternative: none

name: Clever
alternative: no person-level route; schools grant access only to district-approved, Clever-certified apps
notes: Clever's API serves app partners: live district data needs Clever certification (survey plus integration review) and each district's approval; accounts come from schools. Registry hits for 'clever' are unrelated.

Past-cruise Sail & Sign statements can be downloaded from the carnival.com account, and the privacy notice takes access-and-copy requests by email, form or phone where local law grants that right. name: Trustpilot
alternative: Trustpilot review notification emails in the person's mailbox, or the Integration Partner programme for a shared app
notes: No official Trustpilot MCP; the Business API (OAuth for private data) is for Trustpilot for Business accounts and needs the paid API module, with tiered yearly call allowances (Enterprise includes tier 1). Community server: github.com/saulius876-lgtm/trustpilot-reviews (registry), not official.

name: When I Work
alternative: Shift and schedule notification emails in the person's mailbox
notes: No official When I Work MCP found (mcp.wheniwork.com only redirects to the app login); API keys are not self-serve: the employer's account admin must email When I Work, who check the plan is eligible (an upgrade may be needed). Community server: io.usefulapi/when-i-work (hosted by usefulapi.io, routes data through a third party), not official.

name: Hunter
alternative: Hunter API key in the X-API-Key header
notes: Hunter runs a remote MCP on all plans including the free account, with one-click OAuth or the person's API key. Discovery 2026-10-08: DCR yes, CIMD no, S256.

name: LaunchDarkly
alternative: LaunchDarkly local MCP server with an API access token
notes: LaunchDarkly documents a hosted MCP for feature flags, AgentControl and observability (not in its federal or EU instances, which use the local server); a free Developer plan exists. Discovery 2026-10-08: DCR yes, CIMD no, S256.

name: Typefully
alternative: Typefully API key as a bearer header for headless clients
notes: Typefully documents one remote MCP URL for everyone with OAuth sign-in and no API key; no plan requirement is stated. Discovery 2026-10-08: DCR yes, CIMD yes, S256.

name: Invoice Ninja
alternative: Self-hosted Invoice Ninja, where the API is free
notes: No official Invoice Ninja MCP; the REST API takes a token the person creates (X-API-TOKEN), and hosted accounts get REST API access from the Pro plan up (not the free plan). Community server: github.com/ambaloo/invoiceninja-mcp, not official.

name: BrowserStack
alternative: BrowserStack local MCP server (github.com/browserstack/mcp-server) with the person's username and access key
notes: BrowserStack documents a remote MCP that uses OAuth, alongside its local server; testing runs on the person's BrowserStack trial or paid plan. Discovery 2026-10-08: DCR yes, CIMD no, S256.
